 ORDER Case Diary is perused.

This is the first bail application u/S.439 Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

The applicant was arrested on 01.09.2022 by Police Station- Bhitarwar, District- Gwalior (M.P.) in connection with Crime No.325/2022 for the offence punishable under Sections 376(3), 363, 305,

sentences.text: Allegation against present applicant/accused is that deceased prosecutrix aged about 15 years died on 23.07.2022 in the night at about 11:30pm at JH Hospital, Gwalior due to consumption of poison.
On the information, dehati merg under Section 174 of Cr.P.C. of merg 0/22 at police station Bhitarwar was recorded.
On the basis of dehati merg 26/2022 was registered.
Dead body panchnama of the deceased was prepared.
Dead body was sent for post- portem and as per post-mortem report she died due to cardio respiratory failure due to consumption of poison.
Before her death, she was admitted on 09.07.2022.
During treatment, on 12.07.2022, Dr. Kamlesh inquired from prosecutrix and she told him that she had an argument with her mother due to which she consumed poison and she is guilty about her act.

During merg inquiry, statements of father of the deceased were recorded on 29.07.2022 in which he has stated that on 09.07.2022 his younger brother informed him that his daughter is missing, thereafter, his father informed him that his daughter was traced along with present applicant accused.
When he reached at his house, her daughter met him.
Later on, his father told prosecutrix that he saw her on coming on motorcycle of present applicant accused.
They were detained, but present applicant accused fled away.
He took the prosecutrix to his home.
Thereafter, prosecutrix and her family members had dinner.
At about 8:00 pm, prosecutrix started vomiting and prosecutrix stated that she has consumed some medicine and the she became unconscious.
She was brought to Gwalior and admitted to Kamla Raja Hospital.

On,
22.07.2022 when she was in a position to talk, she narrates to him that the incident took place with her by present applicant accused that present applicant accused persuaded her to go with him and committed sexual intercourse with her and gave a medicine to eat and also threatened her with dire consequences of viraling his videos.
Thereafter, she was scared.
Prosecutrix has recorded her statements as a video in this phone.

Thereafter, offence punishable under Sections 376(3), 363, 366,
305 of IPC and Sections 3/4 of POCSO Act was registered.
Applicant accused was arrested on 01.09.2022.
After investigation charge-sheet has been filed.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is aged about 21 years and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is further submitted that after the death of the prosecutrix, her father falsely made allegation against present applicant accused.
During treatment she has stated to treating doctor that she had hot talk with her mother due to which she consumed poison.
After investigation, charge sheet has been submitted.
The applicant is in custody since 01/09/2022 and he is the permanent resident of District- Gwalior (M.P.).
There is no likelihood of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
The applicant is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court.
With the aforesaid submissions, prayer for grant of bail is made.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor for the State opposed the application and prayed for dismissal of the application.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if applicant furnishes a personal bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, he should be released on bail.
